name: siputzx-api
description: SiputZX API — Playground y documentación interactiva de una API para bots de WhatsApp

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
